categories.title: Professional categories
categories.subtitle: Compare what each category may do and what it needs.

RERA.name: Real Estate Referral Agent
RERA.summary: Refers clients to licensed practitioners. Referral-only (Article 10).

FSLA.name: Field Sales and Leasing Agent
FSLA.summary: Entry-level field practitioner working under supervision.

REA.name: Real Estate Agent
REA.summary: Requires at least 3 years as an FSLA or a recognised equivalent.

BROKER.name: Real Estate Broker
BROKER.summary: Requires at least 3 years as a licensed Real Estate Agent.

ASSOCIATE_BROKER.name: Associate Broker
ASSOCIATE_BROKER.summary: A licensed Broker affiliated with a firm under a Principal Broker.

MANAGING_BROKER.name: Managing Broker
MANAGING_BROKER.summary: A licensed Broker who manages an office or branch of a firm.

PRINCIPAL_BROKER.name: Principal Broker
PRINCIPAL_BROKER.summary: Responsible for a firm's supervision, client funds, records and compliance.

REBF.name: Real Estate Brokerage Firm
REBF.summary: A legal entity licensed to carry on brokerage, led by a Principal Broker.

which.q: Which category should I apply for?
which.a: It depends on your age, education, experience and any licence you already hold. The eligibility check recommends a category in about a minute.

upgrade.q: How do I move up to a higher category?
upgrade.a: Most upgrades need three years of documented practice in the category below, plus the training and exam for the new one. Your experience carries forward.

firm.a: Yes. A Real Estate Brokerage Firm registers as a legal entity and must name a licensed Principal Broker.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Draft text pending approval by the Professional Body's Legal & Compliance Officer.
privacy.body: We collect the personal data needed to register and license real estate brokerage practitioners and firms, and to maintain the public register. We collect each item only when your category or application type requires it. Your data is encrypted, access is limited to staff with a need to know, and every access to sensitive records is logged. Only the fields listed in the register rules are ever published. You can request a copy of your data at any time.
